reasonChirho: Like, similar, resembling, compare, liken, be likened, become like, resemble — comparison domain with some cognitive thinking.
Definite time, season, epoch, opportune time, occasion, period, duration, appointed time — time domain.
Seem, appear, think, suppose, believe, seem good, decide, be reputed — cognitive thinking and holding a view.
Intensive reflexive self, reflexive self-reference, possessive reflexive, reciprocal one another, restrain oneself — discourse referentials and self-control.
Fishing net, dragnet, net/snare hunting implement, network/grating — artifacts for fishing/hunting.
Visit with care, select, choose, appoint, designate, punish, set in charge — control/rule (appointing authority) and care.
Recline, sit, be seated, sit enthroned, reign, dwell, reside, inhabit — stances (seated) and ruling.
Gaze intently, look fixedly, look upon, look down, regard, observe attentively, be dismayed — sensory events (visual) and some emotional response.
Wise, skilled in judgment, prudent, shrewd, become wise, make wise, teach wisdom — understanding and learning.
Return, go back, turn back, bring back, restore, answer/reply, repay, turn away/apostatize — movement back and behavioral turning.
Want, wish, desire, will, determine, decree, intend, plan, purpose, be willing, consent, take delight — attitudes/emotions of desiring and thinking.
Womb, belly, stomach, internal body cavity, place of gestation, abdomen — body parts.
Zeal, jealousy, fury, be zealous, earnestly desire, diligence, envy — intense attitudes/emotions.
Say, speak, tell, that which was spoken, command, direct, order, call/name/designate — verbal communication including directive speech.
More, further, farther beyond, greater comparative, exceedingly, majority — degree (comparative increase) and quantity.
Mourning, lamentation, grief, wailing, dirge, funeral song — funerals/burial and emotions of grief.
Purify oneself, purify active, cleanse ritually/physically, purify morally, plaster/daub, goldsmith — religious purification with some artisan work mixed in.
When, when interrogative, while, how long, after, temporal conjunction — time words and discourse markers.
Narrate, describe, relate, tell, reckon, count, calculate, number, recount, enumerate — communication and number/counting.
Scarlet, dyed red, reddened, be red, ruddy, crimson color/dye, scarlet thread/yarn — features of objects (color) and cloth activities.
Twice, as often as, whenever, time/occasion, sevenfold — number/frequency and temporal occasions.
Masters, Master, Lord divine title, master/lord human authority, owner, sir — status titles and authority/rule.
Grass, green vegetation, hay, dried grass, thresh grain, trample, herbs — plants and agricultural processing.
Join oneself to someone, cling devotedly, joined in marriage, stick physically, pile up — association and attachment.
Respect, revere, put to shame, be ashamed, feel shame, disgrace — attitudes/emotions spanning both ends of honor-shame.
Hate, detest, abhor, be hated, love less, enemy — attitudes/emotions of antipathy and hostility.
Wash a body part, wash/launder, be washed, bathe the body, rinse — activities involving liquids, often with ritual significance.
Pain, pang, birth-pang, anguish, be in pain, suffering, sorrow — sensory events (pain) and physiological states.
Change, exchange, transform, various, replace, be changed, different, diverse — nature/class (transformation of type) and becoming.
Withered, dry, dried, dryness, drought, heat, dry land, dry ground — physical states of desiccation and features.
Strive, contend, compete, fight, do battle, wage war, serve as soldier — hostility/strife and contests.
Myriad, ten thousand, innumerable, thousand, two thousand, large number — number domain (large quantities).
Branches, shoot, young branch, bough, growth, vegetation — plant parts.
Sleep physically, sleep figuratively, fall asleep/die euphemism, deep sleep, stupor — physiological state of sleep.
Ask for, request, demand, require, pray, supplicate God, beg, entreat, inquire — communication (requesting) and religious activity.
Truth, reality, true, verity, faithfulness, reliability, genuine, honest, upright — true/false and moral quality.
Tear, rend, throw down, dash to ground, burst, break open, split, prey upon, cut open — physical impact of tearing.
Alone, by oneself, only, unique, sole, exclusively, limbs, members of body, branches, bars — nature/class (uniqueness) mixed with body parts.
Send on a mission, be sent/commissioned, send away/dismiss, dispatch with authority — movement (sending) and communication.
Unclean, impure, common, ritually unclean, profane, be defiled, polluted — religious impurity and features of objects.
Bright, shining, radiant, splendid, magnificent, polish, rubbed bare — features of objects (luminous quality) and physical states.
Stumble metaphorical/spiritual, strike against, fall upon, cause to stumble/sin, be offended, take offense, fall away — happening events and moral failure.
Sign, miraculous sign, mark, impression, standard, ensign, banner, symbolic token — communicative signs and artifacts.
Complacent, carefree, at ease, secure, tranquil, quietness, peace, prosperity — relief from hardship and emotions.
Be crushed, crush/shatter, be humbled, contrite ones, contrite spiritually broken — physical impact and emotional/spiritual humility.
Be sick, be ill, physical ailment, be harmful, be weak, exhausted, feign illness, cause illness — physiological states of disease.
Die physically, die spiritually, have died, the dead persons, lifeless, expire, corpse, carcass — physiological state of death and funerary.
Feed, tend, shepherd, graze, pastor, shepherd/rule messianic — animal husbandry and figurative ruling.
Adulterous, adulteress, commit adultery, sexually immoral, fornicator — moral/ethical violations of sexual nature.
Weakness, frailty, sickness, disease, affliction, illness — physiological states of disease and trouble.
